items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-11-10
items.q: Spike Jones spent... He was so surprised when he saw a Chinese crash cymbal with rivets in it. So I had to go down to one of the music stores and buy one and fix it for him, give it to him.

ctx.x: And Red was, in fact, I got to know Red very well. In fact, he stayed with us here at the house. How old were you when you got to know Red? Oh, not until about 1937, when I was with Grimmer. I'll tell you who else I knew very well, who was also a great drummer. He was a studio drummer. And he had the craziest band in the world. He was a real school drummer. What the hell's his name? You know him. He had horns, cowbells on there. Oh, Spike Jones. Spike Jones. Spike Jones. I'm losing my mind. I can never remember…
Which drummers in this town do you remember the most strong?
